core_obligations: Identify the diagonals: the diagonal of the structure morphism over the base is the diagonal of the stack considered as a morphism over the base, up to a canonical identification (proof lines 1087-1098)

Transfer the properties: the separation properties are defined through the diagonal and are stable under base change, so separatedness of the stack over the base gives the corresponding property of the diagonal of the structure morphism (proof lines 1099-1110)
Conclude: the property of the diagonal being that of a representable separated morphism, the structure morphism itself is separated (proof lines 1111-1113)
proof_roadmap: Δ_{X/S} 与 Δ_{(X→S)/S} 是同一条态射（差一个自然同构）。
分离性按定义就是对 Δ 的要求，且这些性质在基变换下稳定 ⇒ 由 X 在 S 上分离得 Δ_{X/S} 的相应性质。
该性质正是「结构态射分离」所要求的，故 X → S 分离。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that an algebraic stack separated over a base has diagonals with the corresponding separation property and hence a separated structure morphism (author lemma at source lines 1060-1085, label lemma-separated-implies-morphism-separated). The proof (source lines 1087-1114) identifies the diagonal of the structure morphism with the diagonal of the stack over the base, transfers the separation property using stability under base change and reads it as separatedness of the structure morphism (proof lines 1087-1113). The identification of the two diagonals is the substance. H3.
